title: PNOE’s new face mask wants to make lab-grade breath testing a self-serve affair
summary: PNOĒ launches a sleeker, self-serve version of its breath-analyzing mask on October 1, enabling gym-goers to measure VO₂ max and metabolic markers independently in just eight minutes. The technology brings lab-grade breath testing capabilities to consumers without requiring a trained operator.
content: PNOĒ, the Malden, Mass.-based startup whose breath-analyzing mask used to bear an unfortunate resemblance to Bane's, is launching a sleeker self-serve version on October 1 that lets gym-goers measure their VO₂ max and other metabolic markers in eight minutes without a trained operator.

zh.title: PNOE新推出的面罩想让实验室级别的呼吸测试成为自助服务
zh.summary: PNOĒ在10月1日推出了一款更加精巧的自助呼吸分析面罩，使健身爱好者能够在短短八分钟内独立测量VO₂最大值和代谢指标。这项技术为消费者带来了实验室级别的呼吸测试功能，无需经过训练的操作员。

title: Google tests buying from Walmart-owned Flipkart through Gemini and AI Mode in India
summary: Google is testing the ability to purchase select products from Flipkart through Gemini and AI Mode in India, with a broader rollout planned for October. The limited test marks Google's expansion into AI-powered e-commerce shopping experiences in the Indian market.
content: The limited test covers select products and users, with a broader rollout planned for later in October.

zh.title: 谷歌在印度测试通过Gemini和AI模式从沃尔玛旗下Flipkart购物
zh.summary: 谷歌正在测试通过印度Gemini和AI模式从Flipkart购买特定产品的功能，计划在10月进行更广泛的推广。这项有限的测试标志着谷歌在印度市场扩展AI驱动的电子商务购物体验。
